# IronCell Research

> US supplier of research-grade peptides for laboratory research use only. Every product is third-party tested with published certificates of analysis (COAs). Products are not for human consumption, not dietary supplements, and not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

## What IronCell Research is

- Online store at https://ironcellresearch.com/ selling research peptides and laboratory supplies to qualified researchers in the United States.
- Research use only (RUO): all compounds are sold strictly as laboratory reagents for in-vitro research.
- Quality proof: third-party lab testing with COAs published for products; transparent sourcing.
- Fast US shipping on research supplies.
